chunks: Al-Shaykh, may Allah have mercy on him, informed me from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from his father, from Muhammad ibn Yahya, from Muhammad ibn Ahmad ibn Yahya, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Abi Nasr, from Muthanna al-Khayyat, from al-Hasan al-Sayqal, from Abi Abdillah عليه السلام, who said:
The menstruating woman performs ghusl with nine ratls of water.

key_terms.أَرْطَالٍ: ratls, a unit of weight or measure
key_terms.تَغْتَسِلُ: she performs ghusl, the ritual bath

ai.seo_question: How much water is used for the ghusl of a menstruating woman in this hadith?
ai.summary: This hadith states the amount of water used for the ghusl of a menstruating woman. It is a jurisprudential report concerning ritual purity and specifies a measured quantity for performing the bath.
